description: Inspect CI runners. Actions: list_all (every runner on the instance - admin), list_owned (the current user's runners), list_project / list_group (runners available to a project/group), get (single runner by ID), list_jobs (jobs a runner has executed). Related: manage_runner to register.

action.description: Action to perform: list_all, list_owned, list_project, list_group, get, list_jobs

after.description: Cursor for the next page (endCursor) Required for 'list_all', 'list_owned', 'list_project', 'list_group', 'list_jobs' action(s).

first.description: Max items to return (cursor pagination, default 20, max 100) Required for 'list_all', 'list_owned', 'list_project', 'list_group', 'list_jobs' action(s).

group_id.description: Group full path (e.g., 'my-group' or 'my-group/sub') - required by the GraphQL group lookup Required for 'list_group' action(s).

paused.description: Filter by paused state Required for 'list_all', 'list_owned', 'list_project', 'list_group' action(s).

project_id.description: Project full path (e.g., 'my-group/my-project') - required by the GraphQL project lookup Required for 'list_project' action(s).

runner_id.description: Numeric ID of the runner (from a list action); expanded to a global ID internally Required for 'get', 'list_jobs' action(s).

search.description: Filter by description/token substring Required for 'list_all', 'list_owned', 'list_project', 'list_group' action(s).

status.description: Filter by runner status Required for 'list_all', 'list_owned', 'list_project', 'list_group' action(s).

statuses.description: Filter jobs by one or more statuses (e.g. ["FAILED", "CANCELED"]) Required for 'list_jobs' action(s).

tag_list.description: Filter by runners that have ALL of these tags Required for 'list_all', 'list_owned', 'list_project', 'list_group' action(s).

type.description: Filter by runner type Required for 'list_all', 'list_owned', 'list_project', 'list_group' action(s).

name: browse_runners
